correctness.rationale: Checked the actual augmented-chain proof on the clique-fiber graph C_m[K_q], m>=3,q>=2. Expanding each Q^q fiber as its invariant line plus sum-zero augmentation module U yields a literal W-equivariant chain decomposition: U factors cannot be removed by the boundary, and remaining fibers form the link Ind(C_m-N[S]) with determinant orientation. A base dihedral permutation gives orientation sign and signed reduced Lefschetz trace; permutation cycles on U contribute fixed-color count minus one. Gaps after deleting closed neighbors have max(d_j-3,0) path lengths. Known path recurrence gives a unique link homology degree unless a gap length equals 1 mod 3, and cycle recurrence gives the empty-set rank 2 for m divisible by 3. Checks at m=3 and m=4 reproduce discrete-clique and two-K_{q,q} homology; direct count for m=5,q=2 gives beta1=11, as predicted. Finite checks do not prove all m,q; the chain isomorphism and recurrences do.

value.rationale: Complete characters of the natural (S_q)^m semidirect D_m action, including every rotation, reflection and fiber-color permutation, are a natural new invariant beyond ordinary Betti numbers of these graph complexes. Orientations, signed link Lefschetz and all-color cycle traces are exact and can determine rational invariants under subgroups. This is a motivated infinite-parameter equivariant classification, not an assertion of an irreducible or integral decomposition.
